senses.definition: The largest member of the deer family (Alces americanus, sometimes included in Alces alces), of which the male has very large, palmate antlers.
examples: We saw a moose at the edge of the woods.

senses.definition: Any of the extinct moose-like deer of the genera Cervalces and Libralces.

quotes.text: Europe’s giant beavers lived at the same time as the first moose, Libralces gallicus.
quotes.reference: 2018, Tim Flannery, Europe: A Natural History, page 152:

senses.definition: (US, military, slang) An Asian girl taken as a lover.

quotes.text: In military bases in the rear areas it was common for soldiers to have a moose.

quotes.text: Even the lowest ranked serviceman, because of his salary, benefits, and status as an American occupationaire, could afford to “maintain a ‘Moose’ and still take care of his other obligations.”
